task.primary_endpoint: failure to remain within the pitch tolerance in an independent post-action window

history_boundary: Stroke and force limits come from independent mechanical qualification within M03 provisional ceilings of 0.25 mm and 5 N. Equal 21 second schedules end at time 0; each trial uses a freshly prepared replicate. A reset must not erase or substitute the target history.
conditions_boundary: Rod removal changes mechanical loading; the dry condition is a pathway diagnostic. The reference cartridge requires separately declared mass/stiffness matching. Neither control alone proves causality.

excitation.qualification: PCM amplitude is not calibrated mechanical force. Bind renderer, waveform hash, drive transfer and qualified amplitude before physical registration.
excitation.reduced_command: Separate hash-bound no-Dyletsky-probe command, qualified for the reduced acquisition protocol. Observed drive is retained to check actual omission; the full probe command must not be substituted.

policy_definition: Development-only fixed-ridge action-wise quadratic regressions. Fusion_full deliberately shares the same predictor as digital_full; it claims no superior computation. Fusion_reduced is an empirical prospective protocol-subset comparator, not an automatically valid physical certificate.
cost_accounting: Disjoint elapsed-time components. Preparation is 21 s and postwrite components total 20 s. Reset and calibration shares are matched within each condition/history/block. This fixed-epoch v1 cannot demonstrate wall-clock savings merely by omitting a probe and waiting.

confirmation.unit: connected components of blocks sharing a cartridge or acquisition day
confirmation.sampling_assumption: Independent confirmation units sampled from a common target population; exact binomial guards additionally require a common event probability. Neither fresh labels nor distinct days authenticate these assumptions.
confirmation.required_cells_per_block: one freshly prepared episode per condition, write history and policy arm; 36 episodes
confirmation.note: Repeated windows are not independent samples. A pilot with fewer units is descriptive and cannot pass confirmation.

statistics.history_action_gate: In a fixed representative block per independent unit, constant-policy H0/H1 outcomes must be definitely discordant, Fusion-full must apply different actions, and both Fusion outcomes must pass. Under no history effect and conditionally independent fresh preparations, event probability is at most1/2; use exact binomial upper tail.
statistics.method: conservative independent-block bounded-difference Hoeffding tests; exact binomial bound for any-worsening block noninferiority

verdict_boundary: A physical finding is conditional on valid raw records, bounds, randomization, preparation exchangeability and qualified task coupling. Synthetic demonstrations never become physical evidence.

mechanical_qualification.boundary: Provisional commissioning ceilings do not release combined operation. Independent writer and dynamic diaphragm motion qualification are required; PCM amplitude is not displacement.

pitch_readout.pre_action: Identical independently qualified E4 pluck at write end; estimate free-decay pitch in 0.10–1.00 s. Include this read disturbance in every policy arm and record its actual timing.
pitch_readout.outcome: Identical qualified E4 pluck at 18 s; independently estimate pitch in 18.10–20.00 s. No re-use of pre-action pitch as outcome.
pitch_readout.boundary: A driven fixed-frequency sinusoid is not a measurement of natural string pitch. The pitch validation must cover mixed resonances, finite-window/nonstationary error, the calibrated ADC timebase and read disturbance. If the stated bound cannot be qualified, return unresolved pitch.

feature_definitions.pre_pitch_cents: 1200*log2(qualified E4 free-decay pitch / target_Hz), from the common 0.10–1.00 s pitch readout.
feature_definitions.temperature_C: Qualified room sensor mean during 1–2 s. Record water temperature and geometry as setup covariates.
feature_definitions.displacement_m: Qualified writer displacement mean during 1–2 s, at the declared reference zero.
feature_definitions.write_code: H0=0, H1=1, from the assigned preparation log.
feature_definitions.relaxation_N: Force mean over 1.0–1.2 s minus mean over 1.8–2.0 s. This is a force-memory feature, not a modulus.
feature_definitions.bridge_feature: Magnitude of joint multitone E4 bridge-channel coefficient divided by E4 observed electrical loopback coefficient over 2.1–3.9 s, at fixed registered gains. This is a digital channel ratio unless separately converted.
feature_definitions.water_feature: Magnitude of joint multitone E4 hydrophone-channel coefficient divided by E4 observed electrical loopback coefficient over 2.1–3.9 s, at fixed registered gains. This is not pressure per mechanical force.
feature_definitions.validation: Bind an extractor revision implementing these windows, clock/filter corrections and denominator/read-quality rejection. These definitions do not supply a validated physical uncertainty bound.
